entry.title: Updated: engramory#plugin
entry.summary: Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness kept as plain markdown, one fact per file, readable in any editor. The `MEMORY.md` index has a hard 200-line / 25 KB cap enforced by `ctx.tools.guard()`: a write that would grow an over-cap index is denied, while a rewrite that shrinks it always passes, so an oversized index can be compacted step by step. The plugin never writes memories on its own — what is kept is decided by you and the model. The same store is also used by Claude Code, Codex, Kiro and OpenClaw. Exact install spec: dsh-engramory. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: entry_name, description, description_i18n.
